import sys

MOD = 1000000007
MAX = 2000

def main():
    dp = [dict() for _ in range(MAX + 1)]
    ok = [dict() for _ in range(MAX + 1)]
    
    ok[0][0] = 1
    
    for i in range(1, MAX + 1):
        dp_row = dp[i]
        ok_row = ok[i]
        dp_prev = dp[i - 1]
        ok_prev = ok[i - 1]
        
        start = i & 1
        for j in range(start, i + 1, 2):
            if j == 0:
                val = dp_prev.get(j + 1, 0)
                if ok_prev.get(j + 1, 0) == 1:
                    val = (val + 1) % MOD
                else:
                    ok_row[j] = 1
                dp_row[j] = val
            else:
                val = (dp_prev.get(j - 1, 0) + dp_prev.get(j + 1, 0)) % MOD
                if ok_prev.get(j + 1, 0) == 1 or ok_prev.get(j - 1, 0) == 1:
                    val = (val + 1) % MOD
                else:
                    ok_row[j] = 1
                dp_row[j] = val
    
    n = int(sys.stdin.readline())
    print(dp[2 * n].get(0, 0))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
